name: ci_cd_pipeline
description: Set up a CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions

example_params.content:
name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: pytest

example_params.command: git add .github/workflows/ci.yml && git commit -m "Add CI pipeline" && git push

steps.expected_outcome: Workflow pushed, GitHub Actions will trigger
recovery_hints: Ensure changes are staged with git add

steps.expected_outcome: List of recent workflow runs with status

learning_signals: Triggered by: push, pull_request, schedule, workflow_dispatch
Check runs: gh run list, gh run view <id>, gh run watch <id>
